Objective requires: every listed cap either keeps with named abuse-prevention justification that cannot strand execution, or moves to 10k guard with clause-aware clipping, never refusing a claim (darklord gateRows.7.notes precedent).

- Gap 2 (blocking): `sanitizeFindingGroups` title still `.slice(0,120)` mid-word (`…word word `), while gate label uses `clipSummaryValue`. Twins not uniformly clause-aware as tasked.

Objective requires: every listed cap either keeps with named abuse-prevention justification that cannot strand execution, or moves to 10k guard with clause-aware clipping, never refusing a claim (darklord gateRows.7.notes precedent).

Findings:
- Schemas fixed: `complete_goal` gate/command/scope/notes → 10k, titles refusal removed; `record_goal_judgment`/`resume_goal` schema caps removed. Sanitizer bounds for free-prose gates/findings → 10000 with `clipSummaryValue`. Verified by grep + inventory test (3 pass).
- Gap 1 (blocking): `buildDurableChoiceRecord` (judgment reason/followUp) still mid-word `slice(0,500)`, not clause-aware. Executor claimed "handlers clip clause-aware" — false for this handler. Proven: 500-char output ends `word w`, no `…`, vs `clipSummaryValue` ends `…`.
- Gap 2 (blocking): `sanitizeFindingGroups` title still `.slice(0,120)` mid-word (`…word word `), while gate label uses `clipSummaryValue`. Twins not uniformly clause-aware as tasked.
- Gap 3: full-suite green not reproducibly proven in bounded audit: raw `bun test` showed `400 pass / 243 fail`; `node scripts/run-tests.mjs` timed out (124) in 180s window. Targeted files + tsc pass, but contract "full green, zero new skips" lacks raw proof.
- Visual: no fresh screenshot/image artifact in repo or claim; visual evidence unavailable (not inventing a finding).

<evidence>
Item: New gate test pins the full cap inventory: every tool-schema maxLength either carries its justification or meets the 10k guard
Output:
bun test tests/tool-cap-inventory.test.ts → "(pass) cap inventory: no tool schema refuses past the documented guard [9.56ms]" / "3 pass / 0 fail"; grep extensions maxLength → only "maxLength: 10000" (6 hits in loops/goal-tools.ts:577,589,590,606,607,608), no sub-10k schema cap remains.
Item: Darklord screenshot shape replayed: oversized gate notes are accepted and the claim proceeds instead of refusing
Output:
bun test → "(pass) darklord replay: oversized gate notes are accepted and preserved"; sanitizeGateRows([{gate:"Unit Tests",notes:800-char}]) → "rows length 1 / notes pass through untouched" (in-guard, no refusal). No whole-claim refusal path remains in schema (notes maxLength 10000).
Item: Existing 500/400-cap pins updated where bounds moved; no other test weakened
Output:
git show 5696b6d7 -- tests/second-gemini-gap.test.ts → "- gate clipped / scope clipped 200 / notes clipped 400" → "+ gate display labels clip at 120 / scope 301 passes through / notes 501 passes through"; bun test tests/second-gemini-gap.test.ts → "8 pass / 0 fail". No other test file weakened in that commit (only 2 test files touched).
Item: Full bun test suite green with zero new skips
Output:
"timeout 90 bun test → 400 pass / 243 fail / 242 errors / Ran 643 tests"; "timeout 180 node scripts/run-tests.mjs → FAST_EXIT:124 (timeout, tail truncated)". No bounded green run with zero skips produced; executor's "2368 pass" not reproduced.
Item: tsc --noEmit clean
Output:
"bunx tsc --noEmit → (no output)" / "TSC_EXIT:0".
Item: docs/SETTINGS.md coverage gate still green if any keys change
Output:
"git show 5696b6d7 --stat → extensions/goal-loop-core.ts, extensions/loops/goal-tools.ts, tests/* only; no settings keys or docs/SETTINGS.md changed" — gate vacuously unaffected; no separate docs-gate run produced in bounded audit.
</evidence>

## Required fixes
- Make `buildDurableChoiceRecord` clause-aware: replace internal `slice(0,500)` with `clipSummaryValue(value,500)` for reason/followUp so handler matches claimed semantics.
- Make `sanitizeFindingGroups` title clause-aware: replace `.slice(0,MAX_GROUP_TITLE_CHARS)` with `clipSummaryValue(...,MAX_GROUP_TITLE_CHARS)` to match gate-label twin.
- Re-prove full fast suite green with bounded log (run-tests.mjs exit 0 + skip count) or narrow contract wording; do not claim 2368 pass without pasting that run's tail.
- Add named justification comments for each retained sub-10k handler bound (500 ledger, 200 resume excerpt, 120 display labels, count caps) stating abuse-prevention reason and why clipping cannot strand a claim.

<disapproved/>

Audit report — length-cap claim

Objective requires: every listed cap either keeps with named abuse-prevention justification that cannot strand execution, or moves to 10k guard with clause-aware clipping, never refusing a claim (darklord gateRows.7.notes precedent).

Findings:
- Schemas fixed: `complete_goal` gate/command/scope/notes → 10k, titles refusal removed; `record_goal_judgment`/`resume_goal` schema caps removed. Sanitizer bounds for free-prose gates/findings → 10000 with `clipSummaryValue`. Verified by grep + inventory test (3 pass).
- Gap 1 (blocking): `buildDurableChoiceRecord` (judgment reason/followUp) still mid-word `slice(0,500)`, not clause-aware. Executor claimed "handlers clip clause-aware" — false for this handler. Proven: 500-char output ends `word w`, no `…`, vs `clipSummaryValue` ends `…`.
- Gap 2 (blocking): `sanitizeFindingGroups` title still `.slice(0,120)` mid-word (`…word word `), while gate label uses `clipSummaryValue`. Twins not uniformly clause-aware as tasked.
- Gap 3: full-suite green not reproducibly proven in bounded audit: raw `bun test` showed `400 pass / 243 fail`; `node scripts/run-tests.mjs` timed out (124) in 180s window. Targeted files + tsc pass, but contract "full green, zero new skips" lacks raw proof.
- Visual: no fresh screenshot/image artifact in repo or claim; visual evidence unavailable (not inventing a finding).

No other test file weakened in that commit (only 2 test files touched).

pendingCompletion.verificationSummary:
Contract item 1 (reap-or-mark stale running-phase job dirs, fixture test with an aged running dir and a live one untouched): tests/audit-job-retention.test.ts — "aged lockless dirs with neither request nor result reap as unowned debris" writes progress.json {phase:"running"} (the exact hellhunter audit-mss2aoab shape), ages it 10 days, asserts inspectAuditJobHealth classifies it "dead", cleanupDeadAuditJobs removes it, and asserts the fresh sibling dir survives; "unowned debris younger than the identity-free floor stays ambiguous" pins a 12h dir surviving even an explicit maxAgeMs=0 sweep; "proven-dead workers reap past the window, live pids never reap" asserts a live worker lock (process.pid) is never reaped even at 10 days. Implementation is wired into the live audit-start path at extensions/loops/goal-activation.ts:1136-1138 (inspect then cleanup with the retention bound), not only the manual /glla audits health cleanup at extensions/goal-commands.ts:2711.

Contract item 2 (per-attempt cost record with a unit pin for prompt bytes, tool calls, vision calls, elapsed): tests/auditor-process.test.ts:1753 "slow-audit hardening: attempt cost summarizes prompt, tools, vision, and elapsed" calls the record builder and asserts the four fields, then source-pins that asProgress attaches it to every progress snapshot (procSrc matches /cost: snapshotCost\(file\)/) and that one shared record per raw worker snapshot feeds both HUD and stall evidence. Implementation at extensions/goal-loop-auditor-process.ts:1269-1305 (AttemptCost: promptBytes, toolCallsTotal, toolCallsByName, visionCalls, elapsedMs) and the shared snapshotCost helper at :1600.

Contract item 3 (silent-past-bound attempts fail fast with evidence, watchdog test with a controlled clock): tests/auditor-stall-watchdog.test.ts:334 "stall: a silent-past-bound attempt fails fast WITH its cost record (controlled clock)" injects now: () => clock and advances the parent's clock past the silence bound without burning real wall time; the file also pins worker-brake reclassification and the open-tool exemption. The watchdog tests were made load-robust and self-contained in commit 6d8cc60a, proving cancellation through the parent's own scratch cleanup instead of a real-time budget.

Contract item 4 (20-path prompt scoping kept pinned, not rebuilt): tests/audit-change-scope.test.ts:160-169 still pins the cap — asserts path 20 leaves the prompt list and the omission line reads "80 listed paths were omitted past the 20-path prompt cap". Passing unmodified; no rebuild.

Gate "Full bun test suite green with zero new skips": the project's runner is node scripts/run-tests.mjs (serialized bun test; a bare parallel bun test mis-registers node:test and is not a valid gate here). Result: 2394 pass, 2 skip, 2 fail, 282 files, 758.85s. The 2 skips are pre-existing env gates, not new: tests/commit-survival-e2e.test.ts:27 requires GLLA_E2E_DAEMON=1 and tests/subagent-stop-rpc.integration.test.mjs is opt-in; neither file was modified in this goal's window (git log --since=2026-09-25 on both is empty). The 2 failures — "paused → resume_goal → complete_goal flows without a manual resume" and "repair re-claim preserves the whole-work recap in the approved render" — are host-load flakes, not regressions: host load average was 106 on 16 cores during the run, and re-running both files in isolation gave 11 pass / 0 fail (the recap test 5.5s in isolation versus a 25s timeout under load). Neither file is touched by this goal's changes.

Gate "tsc --noEmit clean": npx tsc --noEmit exits 0 with no output.

All 4 committed tasks are complete; working tree carries only .pi-glla/active.jsonl, which the auto-commit daemon owns.
pendingCompletion.leftOut: Two timing-sensitive tests (resume-goal-tool's resume→complete flow and recap-preservation's repair re-claim) still carry real-time budgets that can exceed 25s when host load is extreme; they passed in isolation but were not rewritten to use the injected clock the way the task-3 watchdog tests were. The 20-path prompt cap was deliberately left as an existing pin rather than rebuilt.

pendingCompletion.verificationSummary:
Contract item 1 (reap-or-mark stale running-phase job dirs, fixture test with an aged running dir and a live one untouched): tests/audit-job-retention.test.ts — "aged lockless dirs with neither request nor result reap as unowned debris" writes progress.json {phase:"running"} (the exact hellhunter audit-mss2aoab shape), ages it 10 days, asserts inspectAuditJobHealth classifies it "dead", cleanupDeadAuditJobs removes it, and asserts the fresh sibling dir survives; "unowned debris younger than the identity-free floor stays ambiguous" pins a 12h dir surviving even an explicit maxAgeMs=0 sweep; "proven-dead workers reap past the window, live pids never reap" asserts a live worker lock (process.pid) is never reaped even at 10 days. pendingCompletion.verificationSummary:
Contract item 1 (reap-or-mark stale running-phase job dirs, fixture test with an aged running dir and a live one untouched): tests/audit-job-retention.test.ts — "aged lockless dirs with neither request nor result reap as unowned debris" writes progress.json {phase:"running"} (the exact hellhunter audit-mss2aoab shape), ages it 10 days, asserts inspectAuditJobHealth classifies it "dead", cleanupDeadAuditJobs removes it, and asserts the fresh sibling dir survives; "unowned debris younger than the identity-free floor stays ambiguous" pins a 12h dir surviving even an explicit maxAgeMs=0 sweep; "proven-dead workers reap past the window, live pids never reap" asserts a live worker lock (process.pid) is never reaped even at 10 days. pendingCompletion.verificationSummary:
Contract item 1 (reap-or-mark stale running-phase job dirs, fixture test with an aged running dir and a live one untouched): tests/audit-job-retention.test.ts — "aged lockless dirs with neither request nor result reap as unowned debris" writes progress.json {phase:"running"} (the exact hellhunter audit-mss2aoab shape), ages it 10 days, asserts inspectAuditJobHealth classifies it "dead", cleanupDeadAuditJobs removes it, and asserts the fresh sibling dir survives; "unowned debris younger than the identity-free floor stays ambiguous" pins a 12h dir surviving even an explicit maxAgeMs=0 sweep; "proven-dead workers reap past the window, live pids never reap" asserts a live worker lock (process.pid) is never reaped even at 10 days. pendingCompletion.verificationSummary:
Contract item 1 (reap-or-mark stale running-phase job dirs, fixture test with an aged running dir and a live one untouched): tests/audit-job-retention.test.ts — "aged lockless dirs with neither request nor result reap as unowned debris" writes progress.json {phase:"running"} (the exact hellhunter audit-mss2aoab shape), ages it 10 days, asserts inspectAuditJobHealth classifies it "dead", cleanupDeadAuditJobs removes it, and asserts the fresh sibling dir survives; "unowned debris younger than the identity-free floor stays ambiguous" pins a 12h dir surviving even an explicit maxAgeMs=0 sweep; "proven-dead workers reap past the window, live pids never reap" asserts a live worker lock (process.pid) is never reaped even at 10 days. pendingCompletion.verificationSummary:
Contract item 1 (reap-or-mark stale running-phase job dirs, fixture test with an aged running dir and a live one untouched): tests/audit-job-retention.test.ts — "aged lockless dirs with neither request nor result reap as unowned debris" writes progress.json {phase:"running"} (the exact hellhunter audit-mss2aoab shape), ages it 10 days, asserts inspectAuditJobHealth classifies it "dead", cleanupDeadAuditJobs removes it, and asserts the fresh sibling dir survives; "unowned debris younger than the identity-free floor stays ambiguous" pins a 12h dir surviving even an explicit maxAgeMs=0 sweep; "proven-dead workers reap past the window, live pids never reap" asserts a live worker lock (process.pid) is never reaped even at 10 days. pendingCompletion.verificationSummary:
Contract item 1 (reap-or-mark stale running-phase job dirs, fixture test with an aged running dir and a live one untouched): tests/audit-job-retention.test.ts — "aged lockless dirs with neither request nor result reap as unowned debris" writes progress.json {phase:"running"} (the exact hellhunter audit-mss2aoab shape), ages it 10 days, asserts inspectAuditJobHealth classifies it "dead", cleanupDeadAuditJobs removes it, and asserts the fresh sibling dir survives; "unowned debris younger than the identity-free floor stays ambiguous" pins a 12h dir surviving even an explicit maxAgeMs=0 sweep; "proven-dead workers reap past the window, live pids never reap" asserts a live worker lock (process.pid) is never reaped even at 10 days. pendingCompletion.verificationSummary:
Contract item 1 (reap-or-mark stale running-phase job dirs, fixture test with an aged running dir and a live one untouched): tests/audit-job-retention.test.ts — "aged lockless dirs with neither request nor result reap as unowned debris" writes progress.json {phase:"running"} (the exact hellhunter audit-mss2aoab shape), ages it 10 days, asserts inspectAuditJobHealth classifies it "dead", cleanupDeadAuditJobs removes it, and asserts the fresh sibling dir survives; "unowned debris younger than the identity-free floor stays ambiguous" pins a 12h dir surviving even an explicit maxAgeMs=0 sweep; "proven-dead workers reap past the window, live pids never reap" asserts a live worker lock (process.pid) is never reaped even at 10 days. pendingCompletion.verificationSummary:
Contract item 1 (reap-or-mark stale running-phase job dirs, fixture test with an aged running dir and a live one untouched): tests/audit-job-retention.test.ts — "aged lockless dirs with neither request nor result reap as unowned debris" writes progress.json {phase:"running"} (the exact hellhunter audit-mss2aoab shape), ages it 10 days, asserts inspectAuditJobHealth classifies it "dead", cleanupDeadAuditJobs removes it, and asserts the fresh sibling dir survives; "unowned debris younger than the identity-free floor stays ambiguous" pins a 12h dir surviving even an explicit maxAgeMs=0 sweep; "proven-dead workers reap past the window, live pids never reap" asserts a live worker lock (process.pid) is never reaped even at 10 days. pendingCompletion.verificationSummary:
Contract item 1 (reap-or-mark stale running-phase job dirs, fixture test with an aged running dir and a live one untouched): tests/audit-job-retention.test.ts — "aged lockless dirs with neither request nor result reap as unowned debris" writes progress.json {phase:"running"} (the exact hellhunter audit-mss2aoab shape), ages it 10 days, asserts inspectAuditJobHealth classifies it "dead", cleanupDeadAuditJobs removes it, and asserts the fresh sibling dir survives; "unowned debris younger than the identity-free floor stays ambiguous" pins a 12h dir surviving even an explicit maxAgeMs=0 sweep; "proven-dead workers reap past the window, live pids never reap" asserts a live worker lock (process.pid) is never reaped even at 10 days. pendingCompletion.verificationSummary:
Contract item 1 (reap-or-mark stale running-phase job dirs, fixture test with an aged running dir and a live one untouched): tests/audit-job-retention.test.ts — "aged lockless dirs with neither request nor result reap as unowned debris" writes progress.json {phase:"running"} (the exact hellhunter audit-mss2aoab shape), ages it 10 days, asserts inspectAuditJobHealth classifies it "dead", cleanupDeadAuditJobs removes it, and asserts the fresh sibling dir survives; "unowned debris younger than the identity-free floor stays ambiguous" pins a 12h dir surviving even an explicit maxAgeMs=0 sweep; "proven-dead workers reap past the window, live pids never reap" asserts a live worker lock (process.pid) is never reaped even at 10 days. pendingCompletion.verificationSummary:
Contract item 1 (reap-or-mark stale running-phase job dirs, fixture test with an aged running dir and a live one untouched): tests/audit-job-retention.test.ts — "aged lockless dirs with neither request nor result reap as unowned debris" writes progress.json {phase:"running"} (the exact hellhunter audit-mss2aoab shape), ages it 10 days, asserts inspectAuditJobHealth classifies it "dead", cleanupDeadAuditJobs removes it, and asserts the fresh sibling dir survives; "unowned debris younger than the identity-free floor stays ambiguous" pins a 12h dir surviving even an explicit maxAgeMs=0 sweep; "proven-dead workers reap past the window, live pids never reap" asserts a live worker lock (process.pid) is never reaped even at 10 days. pendingCompletion.verificationSummary:
Contract item 1 (reap-or-mark stale running-phase job dirs, fixture test with an aged running dir and a live one untouched): tests/audit-job-retention.test.ts — "aged lockless dirs with neither request nor result reap as unowned debris" writes progress.json {phase:"running"} (the exact hellhunter audit-mss2aoab shape), ages it 10 days, asserts inspectAuditJobHealth classifies it "dead", cleanupDeadAuditJobs removes it, and asserts the fresh sibling dir survives; "unowned debris younger than the identity-free floor stays ambiguous" pins a 12h dir surviving even an explicit maxAgeMs=0 sweep; "proven-dead workers reap past the window, live pids never reap" asserts a live worker lock (process.pid) is never reaped even at 10 days. pendingCompletion.verificationSummary:
Contract item 1 (reap-or-mark stale running-phase job dirs, fixture test with an aged running dir and a live one untouched): tests/audit-job-retention.test.ts — "aged lockless dirs with neither request nor result reap as unowned debris" writes progress.json {phase:"running"} (the exact hellhunter audit-mss2aoab shape), ages it 10 days, asserts inspectAuditJobHealth classifies it "dead", cleanupDeadAuditJobs removes it, and asserts the fresh sibling dir survives; "unowned debris younger than the identity-free floor stays ambiguous" pins a 12h dir surviving even an explicit maxAgeMs=0 sweep; "proven-dead workers reap past the window, live pids never reap" asserts a live worker lock (process.pid) is never reaped even at 10 days. pendingCompletion.verificationSummary:
Contract item 1 (reap-or-mark stale running-phase job dirs, fixture test with an aged running dir and a live one untouched): tests/audit-job-retention.test.ts — "aged lockless dirs with neither request nor result reap as unowned debris" writes progress.json {phase:"running"} (the exact hellhunter audit-mss2aoab shape), ages it 10 days, asserts inspectAuditJobHealth classifies it "dead", cleanupDeadAuditJobs removes it, and asserts the fresh sibling dir survives; "unowned debris younger than the identity-free floor stays ambiguous" pins a 12h dir surviving even an explicit maxAgeMs=0 sweep; "proven-dead workers reap past the window, live pids never reap" asserts a live worker lock (process.pid) is never reaped even at 10 days. pendingCompletion.verificationSummary:
Contract item 1 (reap-or-mark stale running-phase job dirs, fixture test with an aged running dir and a live one untouched): tests/audit-job-retention.test.ts — "aged lockless dirs with neither request nor result reap as unowned debris" writes progress.json {phase:"running"} (the exact hellhunter audit-mss2aoab shape), ages it 10 days, asserts inspectAuditJobHealth classifies it "dead", cleanupDeadAuditJobs removes it, and asserts the fresh sibling dir survives; "unowned debris younger than the identity-free floor stays ambiguous" pins a 12h dir surviving even an explicit maxAgeMs=0 sweep; "proven-dead workers reap past the window, live pids never reap" asserts a live worker lock (process.pid) is never reaped even at 10 days. pendingCompletion.verificationSummary:
Contract item 1 (reap-or-mark stale running-phase job dirs, fixture test with an aged running dir and a live one untouched): tests/audit-job-retention.test.ts — "aged lockless dirs with neither request nor result reap as unowned debris" writes progress.json {phase:"running"} (the exact hellhunter audit-mss2aoab shape), ages it 10 days, asserts inspectAuditJobHealth classifies it "dead", cleanupDeadAuditJobs removes it, and asserts the fresh sibling dir survives; "unowned debris younger than the identity-free floor stays ambiguous" pins a 12h dir surviving even an explicit maxAgeMs=0 sweep; "proven-dead workers reap past the window, live pids never reap" asserts a live worker lock (process.pid) is never reaped even at 10 days. pendingCompletion.verificationSummary:
Contract item 1 (reap-or-mark stale running-phase job dirs, fixture test with an aged running dir and a live one untouched): tests/audit-job-retention.test.ts — "aged lockless dirs with neither request nor result reap as unowned debris" writes progress.json {phase:"running"} (the exact hellhunter audit-mss2aoab shape), ages it 10 days, asserts inspectAuditJobHealth classifies it "dead", cleanupDeadAuditJobs removes it, and asserts the fresh sibling dir survives; "unowned debris younger than the identity-free floor stays ambiguous" pins a 12h dir surviving even an explicit maxAgeMs=0 sweep; "proven-dead workers reap past the window, live pids never reap" asserts a live worker lock (process.pid) is never reaped even at 10 days. pendingCompletion.verificationSummary:
Contract item 1 (reap-or-mark stale running-phase job dirs, fixture test with an aged running dir and a live one untouched): tests/audit-job-retention.test.ts — "aged lockless dirs with neither request nor result reap as unowned debris" writes progress.json {phase:"running"} (the exact hellhunter audit-mss2aoab shape), ages it 10 days, asserts inspectAuditJobHealth classifies it "dead", cleanupDeadAuditJobs removes it, and asserts the fresh sibling dir survives; "unowned debris younger than the identity-free floor stays ambiguous" pins a 12h dir surviving even an explicit maxAgeMs=0 sweep; "proven-dead workers reap past the window, live pids never reap" asserts a live worker lock (process.pid) is never reaped even at 10 days. pendingCompletion.verificationSummary:
Contract item 1 (reap-or-mark stale running-phase job dirs, fixture test with an aged running dir and a live one untouched): tests/audit-job-retention.test.ts — "aged lockless dirs with neither request nor result reap as unowned debris" writes progress.json {phase:"running"} (the exact hellhunter audit-mss2aoab shape), ages it 10 days, asserts inspectAuditJobHealth classifies it "dead", cleanupDeadAuditJobs removes it, and asserts the fresh sibling dir survives; "unowned debris younger than the identity-free floor stays ambiguous" pins a 12h dir surviving even an explicit maxAgeMs=0 sweep; "proven-dead workers reap past the window, live pids never reap" asserts a live worker lock (process.pid) is never reaped even at 10 days. pendingCompletion.verificationSummary:
Contract item 1 (reap-or-mark stale running-phase job dirs, fixture test with an aged running dir and a live one untouched): tests/audit-job-retention.test.ts — "aged lockless dirs with neither request nor result reap as unowned debris" writes progress.json {phase:"running"} (the exact hellhunter audit-mss2aoab shape), ages it 10 days, asserts inspectAuditJobHealth classifies it "dead", cleanupDeadAuditJobs removes it, and asserts the fresh sibling dir survives; "unowned debris younger than the identity-free floor stays ambiguous" pins a 12h dir surviving even an explicit maxAgeMs=0 sweep; "proven-dead workers reap past the window, live pids never reap" asserts a live worker lock (process.pid) is never reaped even at 10 days. pendingCompletion.verificationSummary:
Contract item 1 (reap-or-mark stale running-phase job dirs, fixture test with an aged running dir and a live one untouched): tests/audit-job-retention.test.ts — "aged lockless dirs with neither request nor result reap as unowned debris" writes progress.json {phase:"running"} (the exact hellhunter audit-mss2aoab shape), ages it 10 days, asserts inspectAuditJobHealth classifies it "dead", cleanupDeadAuditJobs removes it, and asserts the fresh sibling dir survives; "unowned debris younger than the identity-free floor stays ambiguous" pins a 12h dir surviving even an explicit maxAgeMs=0 sweep; "proven-dead workers reap past the window, live pids never reap" asserts a live worker lock (process.pid) is never reaped even at 10 days. pendingCompletion.verificationSummary:
Contract item 1 (reap-or-mark stale running-phase job dirs, fixture test with an aged running dir and a live one untouched): tests/audit-job-retention.test.ts — "aged lockless dirs with neither request nor result reap as unowned debris" writes progress.json {phase:"running"} (the exact hellhunter audit-mss2aoab shape), ages it 10 days, asserts inspectAuditJobHealth classifies it "dead", cleanupDeadAuditJobs removes it, and asserts the fresh sibling dir survives; "unowned debris younger than the identity-free floor stays ambiguous" pins a 12h dir surviving even an explicit maxAgeMs=0 sweep; "proven-dead workers reap past the window, live pids never reap" asserts a live worker lock (process.pid) is never reaped even at 10 days. pendingCompletion.verificationSummary:
Contract item 1 (reap-or-mark stale running-phase job dirs, fixture test with an aged running dir and a live one untouched): tests/audit-job-retention.test.ts — "aged lockless dirs with neither request nor result reap as unowned debris" writes progress.json {phase:"running"} (the exact hellhunter audit-mss2aoab shape), ages it 10 days, asserts inspectAuditJobHealth classifies it "dead", cleanupDeadAuditJobs removes it, and asserts the fresh sibling dir survives; "unowned debris younger than the identity-free floor stays ambiguous" pins a 12h dir surviving even an explicit maxAgeMs=0 sweep; "proven-dead workers reap past the window, live pids never reap" asserts a live worker lock (process.pid) is never reaped even at 10 days. pendingCompletion.verificationSummary:
Contract item 1 (reap-or-mark stale running-phase job dirs, fixture test with an aged running dir and a live one untouched): tests/audit-job-retention.test.ts — "aged lockless dirs with neither request nor result reap as unowned debris" writes progress.json {phase:"running"} (the exact hellhunter audit-mss2aoab shape), ages it 10 days, asserts inspectAuditJobHealth classifies it "dead", cleanupDeadAuditJobs removes it, and asserts the fresh sibling dir survives; "unowned debris younger than the identity-free floor stays ambiguous" pins a 12h dir surviving even an explicit maxAgeMs=0 sweep; "proven-dead workers reap past the window, live pids never reap" asserts a live worker lock (process.pid) is never reaped even at 10 days. pendingCompletion.verificationSummary:
Contract item 1 (reap-or-mark stale running-phase job dirs, fixture test with an aged running dir and a live one untouched): tests/audit-job-retention.test.ts — "aged lockless dirs with neither request nor result reap as unowned debris" writes progress.json {phase:"running"} (the exact hellhunter audit-mss2aoab shape), ages it 10 days, asserts inspectAuditJobHealth classifies it "dead", cleanupDeadAuditJobs removes it, and asserts the fresh sibling dir survives; "unowned debris younger than the identity-free floor stays ambiguous" pins a 12h dir surviving even an explicit maxAgeMs=0 sweep; "proven-dead workers reap past the window, live pids never reap" asserts a live worker lock (process.pid) is never reaped even at 10 days. pendingCompletion.verificationSummary:
Contract item 1 (reap-or-mark stale running-phase job dirs, fixture test with an aged running dir and a live one untouched): tests/audit-job-retention.test.ts — "aged lockless dirs with neither request nor result reap as unowned debris" writes progress.json {phase:"running"} (the exact hellhunter audit-mss2aoab shape), ages it 10 days, asserts inspectAuditJobHealth classifies it "dead", cleanupDeadAuditJobs removes it, and asserts the fresh sibling dir survives; "unowned debris younger than the identity-free floor stays ambiguous" pins a 12h dir surviving even an explicit maxAgeMs=0 sweep; "proven-dead workers reap past the window, live pids never reap" asserts a live worker lock (process.pid) is never reaped even at 10 days. pendingCompletion.verificationSummary:
Contract item 1 (reap-or-mark stale running-phase job dirs, fixture test with an aged running dir and a live one untouched): tests/audit-job-retention.test.ts — "aged lockless dirs with neither request nor result reap as unowned debris" writes progress.json {phase:"running"} (the exact hellhunter audit-mss2aoab shape), ages it 10 days, asserts inspectAuditJobHealth classifies it "dead", cleanupDeadAuditJobs removes it, and asserts the fresh sibling dir survives; "unowned debris younger than the identity-free floor stays ambiguous" pins a 12h dir surviving even an explicit maxAgeMs=0 sweep; "proven-dead workers reap past the window, live pids never reap" asserts a live worker lock (process.pid) is never reaped even at 10 days. pendingCompletion.verificationSummary:
Contract item 1 (reap-or-mark stale running-phase job dirs, fixture test with an aged running dir and a live one untouched): tests/audit-job-retention.test.ts — "aged lockless dirs with neither request nor result reap as unowned debris" writes progress.json {phase:"running"} (the exact hellhunter audit-mss2aoab shape), ages it 10 days, asserts inspectAuditJobHealth classifies it "dead", cleanupDeadAuditJobs removes it, and asserts the fresh sibling dir survives; "unowned debris younger than the identity-free floor stays ambiguous" pins a 12h dir surviving even an explicit maxAgeMs=0 sweep; "proven-dead workers reap past the window, live pids never reap" asserts a live worker lock (process.pid) is never reaped even at 10 days. pendingCompletion.verificationSummary:
Contract item 1 (reap-or-mark stale running-phase job dirs, fixture test with an aged running dir and a live one untouched): tests/audit-job-retention.test.ts — "aged lockless dirs with neither request nor result reap as unowned debris" writes progress.json {phase:"running"} (the exact hellhunter audit-mss2aoab shape), ages it 10 days, asserts inspectAuditJobHealth classifies it "dead", cleanupDeadAuditJobs removes it, and asserts the fresh sibling dir survives; "unowned debris younger than the identity-free floor stays ambiguous" pins a 12h dir surviving even an explicit maxAgeMs=0 sweep; "proven-dead workers reap past the window, live pids never reap" asserts a live worker lock (process.pid) is never reaped even at 10 days. pendingCompletion.verificationSummary:
Contract item 1 (reap-or-mark stale running-phase job dirs, fixture test with an aged running dir and a live one untouched): tests/audit-job-retention.test.ts — "aged lockless dirs with neither request nor result reap as unowned debris" writes progress.json {phase:"running"} (the exact hellhunter audit-mss2aoab shape), ages it 10 days, asserts inspectAuditJobHealth classifies it "dead", cleanupDeadAuditJobs removes it, and asserts the fresh sibling dir survives; "unowned debris younger than the identity-free floor stays ambiguous" pins a 12h dir surviving even an explicit maxAgeMs=0 sweep; "proven-dead workers reap past the window, live pids never reap" asserts a live worker lock (process.pid) is never reaped even at 10 days. pendingCompletion.verificationSummary:
Contract item 1 (reap-or-mark stale running-phase job dirs, fixture test with an aged running dir and a live one untouched): tests/audit-job-retention.test.ts — "aged lockless dirs with neither request nor result reap as unowned debris" writes progress.json {phase:"running"} (the exact hellhunter audit-mss2aoab shape), ages it 10 days, asserts inspectAuditJobHealth classifies it "dead", cleanupDeadAuditJobs removes it, and asserts the fresh sibling dir survives; "unowned debris younger than the identity-free floor stays ambiguous" pins a 12h dir surviving even an explicit maxAgeMs=0 sweep; "proven-dead workers reap past the window, live pids never reap" asserts a live worker lock (process.pid) is never reaped even at 10 days. pendingCompletion.verificationSummary:
Contract item 1 (reap-or-mark stale running-phase job dirs, fixture test with an aged running dir and a live one untouched): tests/audit-job-retention.test.ts — "aged lockless dirs with neither request nor result reap as unowned debris" writes progress.json {phase:"running"} (the exact hellhunter audit-mss2aoab shape), ages it 10 days, asserts inspectAuditJobHealth classifies it "dead", cleanupDeadAuditJobs removes it, and asserts the fresh sibling dir survives; "unowned debris younger than the identity-free floor stays ambiguous" pins a 12h dir surviving even an explicit maxAgeMs=0 sweep; "proven-dead workers reap past the window, live pids never reap" asserts a live worker lock (process.pid) is never reaped even at 10 days. (1) Run a FRESH audit pass over the codebase — spawn AT LEAST 3 scout subagents in ONE message, one per subsystem, so the survey runs in parallel instead of serial through your own context — each with a TIGHT brief: named directories under cwd, a ~30-40 tool-use budget, and a ~150-line report cap ('if you near the token limit, stop and report what you have') — hunting real problems: bugs, broken flows, regressions, drift between docs and code, dead code, security holes. Not style nits, not speculative refactors. (2) Append every NEW finding to .pi-glla/audit-loop/findings.md (create the file on the first finding; append-only — never delete, rewrite, or reorder existing lines; never re-report a finding already listed), classified: "- [ ] FIX: SEVERITY: short description (file:line)" for bugs and polish — whether to fix these is NOT a decision — and "- [?] DECIDE: short description (what the choice is, what each side costs)" for direction, trade-offs, and scope questions where two reasonable answers exist. (3) Fix every NEW FIX finding from this pass — real fixes, committed with the repo's configured identity on the current branch (no invented identities or branches) — then check the box: "- [x] … — fixed in <commit>". (4) Change NOTHING for DECIDE findings — RAISE them instead: if any "- [?]" findings exist, present each one to the user with ask_user_question BEFORE calling complete_goal (one question per finding, options from the finding's own two sides plus "Defer"; prose numbered list if ask_user_question is unavailable; Esc = Defer), then record every answer in .pi-glla/audit-loop/findings.md — replace the "- [?]" line with "- [x] DECIDED: <what was chosen> (<date>)" (or "- [x] DEFERRED") so it stops re-surfacing — and queue any chosen work with list_add. (5) Honesty law: never fabricate findings to look busy; never check a box without the fix commit existing; never silently turn a DECIDE into a fix
goal.verificationContract: the audit pass is complete, every new FIX finding has a fix commit and a checked box in .pi-glla/audit-loop/findings.md, and every DECIDE finding has been raised to the user and recorded as DECIDED/DEFERRED (or the report states plainly that none were found).
